body: Ask Var finns …? for a category and Har ni …? to check stock.

sections.title: The article moves to the end
body: Indefinite articles stand before nouns: en banan, ett äpple. Basic definite forms attach an ending: bananen, äpplet.
Many en-words add -en/-n; many ett-words add -et/-t. Learn forms with each noun.
Use measures such as ett kilo äpplen, en liter mjölk and två paket ris.

assignment.title: Episode 11 mission: Shopping and definite noun forms
assignment.instructions:
LISTEN: Hear twice and answer: Which fruit is bought?

READ: Read for purpose and detail. Answer: Which product is priced per item?

SPEAK: Ask where two items are and request a quantity. Try once unaided, then improve one detail.

WRITE: Write five list items and one definite-noun sentence. Check word order, forms, and purpose.

TRANSFER: Replace a per-kilo product with a per-item one.

RETURN: Make banan and äpple definite.
assignment.model:
Speaking: Ursäkta, var finns brödet? Jag behöver också en liter mjölk.
Writing: Mjölk, bröd, äpplen, ris, kaffe.
Mjölken finns längst in.

takeaways: Use: Var finns brödet och mjölken?
